description: a stern woman grand inquisitor with dark hair tied back, blackened plate armour with golden holy symbols, a long red cape and a red tabard, a heavy warhammer in her right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
